title: Advancement Buff
description: Enhances advancements by granting loot rewards upon completion, scaled by difficulty.
body: Makes leveling up more rewarding by giving you loot each time you complete a challenge or advance in a custom progression system. The harder the task—like defeating a raid, clearing a bastion, or surviving a hardcore boss fight—the better the loot. This turns progression into more than just XP grinding, giving you real reasons to chase high-risk objectives and explore deeper parts of the game.
